claim_verbatim: I define but do not explicitly study neutral EE mutations further here, because such mutations cannot be reliably identified in large populations with today's technology to measure fitness.
tier: LEXIS_VERIFIED_PRIMARY (PDF fetched and text-extracted this pass)
interpretation: The field DEFINED the exact matched-present-state quantity Prometheus wants and declined to measure it for a stated measurement-precision reason. This is far stronger than 'nobody thought of it'.

claim_verbatim: I do not explicitly study neutral EE mutations here, because such mutations cannot be reliably identified for large populations with today's technology to measure fitness, and the number of 1-mutant neighbor pairs where both fitness measurements happen to be exactly equal is so small as to be negligible (38 pairs or 0.02% of all pairs for the protein dataset and 34 or 0.06% for the RNA dataset).
interpretation: THE FEASIBILITY CONSTRAINT ON HC-R01's TOP RECOMMENDATION. Exact fitness equality yields n=38 (protein) and n=34 (RNA). A neutral-EE re-analysis must widen the band to |dw| < measurement error and must compute its power BEFORE being chosen. HC-R01 quoted only the first half of this sentence.

claim_verbatim: For a neutral mutation (dw = 0) to be EE, I require that mean-fitness(neighbours of m) - mean-fitness(neighbours of wt) > 0
location: Eq.1, paraphrased from the PDF's mangled math glyphs
tier: LEXIS_VERIFIED_PRIMARY (glyph-mangled in extraction; symbols reconstructed, MEANING verified against the plain-words gloss at Eq.3)
interpretation: This is the only construction found in any surveyed work that subtracts the current-state contribution BY DEFINITION. It is the direct methodological answer to HC-T01's K7 failure.

claim_verbatim: the neighbors of m must have higher fitness (relative to m) than the neighbors of the wild-type (relative to the wild-type) ... This condition is equivalent to requiring that m shows on average positive epistasis with the mutations leading to its neighbors
interpretation: Accessibility-beyond-current-state is formally identical to average positive epistasis. Prometheus should know it is chasing an object the field already has a name and a theory for.

claim_verbatim: current best fitness (CHEAP) rho = -1.000 / -0.686 / -0.987 ; modular degree (ACCESSIBILITY) rho = -0.950 / -0.624 / -0.949 ... K7 FIRED ... The accessibility detector adds NO independent predictive value for acquisition in this design.
interpretation: HC-T01's own executed result. Accessibility was strictly WORSE than the cheapest state variable in all three columns. Note all rho are large and negative, which is the signature of regression toward a fixed ceiling: subsequent GAIN is bounded by (ceiling - current), so anything correlated with current fitness predicts gain. See PC-06.

claim_verbatim: Note the 100->500 column is partly degenerate: once most runs reach the optimum, gain becomes an arithmetic function of the current value.
interpretation: The seat noticed the ceiling artifact for one column. LEXIS EXTENDS THIS: the artifact is structural for ALL columns whenever the outcome is gain toward a bounded optimum. K7 as specified is therefore close to unwinnable regardless of whether accessibility carries real information. This is a DESIGN defect, not a result.

claim_verbatim: M(P_0) is exactly 0.00000 for modular degree and -0.00004 for neutral degree ... verdict VACUOUS
interpretation: The preregistered generation-zero mechanical-effect null - one of the six cells of the claimed residual composition - was UNIMPLEMENTABLE in this substrate: a one-symbol founder gives beta nothing to act on. It was replaced mid-flight by a contemporaneous frozen probe. Any restatement of the residual cell must say the null is substrate-dependent.

claim_verbatim: beta = 0 populations cannot evolve the second-type operators available to beta > 0 populations. So the experiment cannot separate 'history reorganised comparable machinery into different future accessibility' from 'only one treatment was allowed to construct an additional class of representational machinery'.
interpretation: The machinery-presence confound. This is the empirical answer to directive question 6: the operator ablation made causal identification WORSE than a selection-side intervention would have, because the ablated arm lacks the machinery class entirely rather than possessing a reorganised version of it.

claim_verbatim: (A) The phenotype abundance of the target strongly affects the success of adaptation (r = 0.76, P = 2.2e-4). (B) The phenotype abundance at the start of the simulation has no effect on the evolutionary outcome (r = -0.023, P = 0.17).
source: Cowperthwaite, Economo, Harcombe, Miller & Meyers 2008, PLoS Comput Biol 4(7):e1000110
location: Figure 6 caption, verified in the publisher PDF
tier: LEXIS_VERIFIED_PRIMARY (PDF fetched and text-extracted THIS PASS; upgraded from LANE_VERIFIED)
interpretation: THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT EXTERNAL DATUM FOR THIS ADJUDICATION. It is the accessibility of the DESTINATION that predicted acquisition, not the accessibility of the ORIGIN. HC-T01 measures ORIGIN-side accessibility. A published, well-powered negative on exactly the origin-side claim, in RNA, seventeen years before HC-T01, and it agrees with HC-T01's own K7 kill.
design: 2,400 stochastic simulations; 10 founding phenotypes spanning the abundance range x 20 genotypes drawn from each founding neutral network = 200 isogenic founding populations; 1,000,000 generations; U = 0.0003; N = 1000. Their accessibility statistic A tracks phenotype abundance almost perfectly (their words: 'an almost perfect relationship between the two quantities', Fig 5A).

claim_verbatim: the mutation rate to high-fitness types declined monotonically with q in the RNA data, and so we used a linear regression of this relationship in our analytic predictions.

interpretation: The only within-run accessibility-at-t / acquisition-at-t+n design found anywhere cannot answer the conditioning question because accessibility was MODELLED as a function of robustness. Collinear by construction.

claim_verbatim: Parameters for random mutation introduction experiments: Every 300 generations every individual was mutated at every connection in the GRN by a value randomly drawn from a normal distribution (N(0,1)) in addition to the regular mutation step that was still applied every generation.

interpretation: The mechanism manipulated is the MAGNITUDE/SCHEDULE of variation, not the structure of the genotype-phenotype map. Closer to HC-T01's beta knob than to Kounios's map swap. Note it is ADDITIVE to the normal operator, so it does not create a machinery-presence confound: both arms retain the same machinery.
